scope: Real Pixi Sprite allocation/transform microbenchmark; no GPU rendering, not classroom FPS evidence

checks.cause: New pool used setTransform, which is not a Pixi8 Sprite method. Replaced with explicit property setters; prior body tests passed.

checks.coverage: Transform/order parity, bounded reserve with 150 active sprites across five clears, same 12000-shot lifecycle allocation comparison
Strengthened unique retired texture assertion: pool releases reference without destroying shared texture

limits: Allocation counts are deterministic; elapsed/process CPU timings are a single shared-PC sample, not a speed guarantee.
Dormant reserve adds up to 64 detached Sprite objects, emptied on room reset and Canvas fallback. Active count is not capped.
Browser render, GPU, real-device and end-to-end performance must be reported separately.
